prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universal “best” roofing company for every homeowner — the right contractor depends on your needs (roof size and material, budget, insurance claim, timeline, warranty expectations, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. Before I look up local options, here’s how to identify the best roofing company in Dallas and what to ask.

How to choose the best roofer
- Local reputation and experience: preferred if they’ve done many jobs in Dallas/Fort Worth and understand local code and weather issues.  
- Proper insurance: verify current general liability and workers’ comp (get a certificate of insurance).  
- Credentials and manufacturer certifications: look for GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred, etc. These give access to better warranties.  
- Written estimate and contract: must include scope, materials, start/end dates, cleanup, and payment schedule.  
- Warranty: distinguish material (manufacturer) warranty vs. workmanship warranty from the contractor; get both in writing.  
- Permits and inspection: contractor should pull required permits and handle inspections.  
- Insurance-claim experience: if you’re dealing with storm damage, choose a roofer experienced with insurance adjusters.  
- References and photos: ask for recent local references and before/after photos. Check Google, Yelp, BBB reviews.  
- Lien waivers and final paperwork: ensure they provide lien releases upon final payment.

Red flags
- High-pressure sales tactics or demand for large upfront cash payments.  
- No written estimate or unwillingness to provide proof of insurance.  
- Extremely low bids far below others (could be inferior materials or workmanship).  
- Poor online reviews about clean-up, missed timelines, or unresolved warranty work.

Questions to ask a prospective roofer
- Are you licensed/registered to work in Dallas (and any specific city requirements)?  
- Can you provide proof of insurance and references from local jobs?  
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle/manufacturer I want?  
- Who will pull permits and handle inspections?  
- What is your workmanship warranty and what does it cover?  
- What is the projected start and completion date?  
- How do you handle unexpected issues found once the old roof is removed?

If you want, I can:
- Look up the top-rated roofers in your Dallas ZIP code and give a short vetted list (with ratings, contact info, and why they’re recommended).  
- Compare 3 estimates and point out differences in materials, scope, and warranty.

Tell me your ZIP code and whether this is a residential or commercial replacement, what roofing material you want (asphalt shingle, metal, tile), and whether insurance is involved — I’ll pull a tailored shortlist.
